item.title: This house trumpets its history in the face of gentrification. Now it's a landmark
item.description: A house in San Francisco covered in the painted faces of Latin rock artists was formally landmarked by the city. Its neighborhood has seen skyrocketing home prices and decades of redevelopment.

item.title: Inside the Democratic task force preparing for if Trump interferes in the midterms
item.description: As Election Day draws nearer, Democrats are preparing for a range of scenarios, intent on avoiding what they see as the failure of imagination that kept lawmakers from anticipating the Jan. 6 attack.

item.title: A melting glacier contributed to the deadly Nepal floods. We can expect more like this
item.description: As the climate continues to warm, scientists warn that the frequency of disasters like the floods in Nepal will increase.

item.title: Morning news brief
item.description: Over 400 people were killed by the flash floods in Nepal and Tibet, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh to give a speech Friday, Judge hears argument in fight to restore Trump's name to Kennedy Center.
